# Simply Better Core

### The Heart of the Simply Better Suite

**Simply Better Core** is the central foundation of the **Simply Better Suite (SBS)** — a modular collection of **Fabric 1.21.1** server-side mods inspired by the legendary _EssentialsX_ plugin.  
It serves as the unified database and data management system that powers all other modules in the suite.

All SBS modules depend on **Simply Better Core**, which handles **configuration**, **database operations**, and **inter-module communication** — ensuring consistent data behavior and cross-compatibility across the entire ecosystem.

---

## ✨ Features

-   Centralized, scalable database management system  
-   Provides a full **CRUD API** (Create, Read, Update, Delete) for all registered SBS modules  
-   Enables seamless **data synchronization** between modules  
-   Designed for **scalability**, **stability**, and **ease of extension**  
-   Fully integrated with all Simply Better Suite components  
-   Optimized for **Fabric 1.21.1** performance and low-overhead async data operations  

---

## 💬 Commands & 🔐 Permissions

**Simply Better Core** currently provides **no user-facing commands or permissions**.  
It operates entirely as a **backend service layer** for other modules in the suite.

---

## 📚 Documentations

-   [Getting Started](https://docs-sbs.godsmg.com/#get-started)
-   [Configuration](https://docs-sbs.godsmg.com/documentation/common-informations/configuration)
-   [Developer Guide](https://docs-sbs.godsmg.com/documentation/for-devs/get-started)

---

## ⚙️ Requirements

-   **Minecraft:** 1.21.1  
-   **Fabric Loader:** ≥ 0.17.2+  
-   **Fabric API**

Optional:

-   **LuckPerms** _(for advanced permission integration in dependent modules)_  
-   **Fabric Permissions API**

---

## 🧠 Technical Notes

-   Built with a **modular architecture** — serves as the data backbone for all other SBS modules  
-   Implements **asynchronous database operations** for maximum performance and minimal latency  
-   Supports **cross-module data calls** through standardized CRUD interfaces  
-   No direct player interaction — purely backend and API-focused  
-   Configuration stored in `/config/simplybetter/sbcore-config.json`

---

## 🔗 Integration

-   Required by all **Simply Better Suite** modules (Homes, TP, Economy, etc.)  
-   Provides **shared data and synchronization layers** across modules  
-   Designed for **future expansion**, allowing new modules to register custom tables and handlers  
-   Ensures **data consistency and interoperability** across the suite
